jobs.occupation: Team Lead Technical Operations (all genders) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.employer_name: DIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH
jobs.description: About the roleJoin us as our Team Lead Technical Operations and help shape the reliability, resilience, and future of DIGITEC’s SaaS operations!DIGITEC is a leading provider of Foreign Exchange SaaS solutions, specializing in FX Swaps, NDFs, and Money Markets. We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Team Lead Technical Operations to lead our TechOps team and ensure the reliable, secure, resilient, and scalable operation of our D3 SaaS platforms .In this role, you will combine technical leadership, people development, and operational ownership, leading a multinational TechOps team of four people based across Hamburg, London, and Singapore. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will play a key role in evolving our operations from manual and infrastructure-centric processes toward a more automated, standardized, observable, and cloud-native environment, applying SRE and Operational Excellence principles.You will work closely with DevOps, Development, Security, Product, and Service Delivery to continuously improve how we operate our platforms and deliver reliable services to our clients.Your ResponsibilitiesTechnical Operations & Reliability• Lead the reliable, resilient, secure, and scalable operation of our D3 SaaS platforms.• Drive service reliability using SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, and reliability engineering.• Oversee incident, problem, and escalation management while strengthening Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and technical resilience.Operational Excellence & Transformation• Drive the evolution toward automated, standardized, observable, and cloud-native operations.• Continuously improve operational processes, tooling, automation, and KPIs to increase reliability and efficiency.• Promote a culture of Operational Excellence, continuous improvement, and effective problem management.Team Leadership & Collaboration• Lead and develop our multinational TechOps team across Hamburg, London, and Singapore, fostering ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.• Provide technical and operational direction while remaining hands-on where needed.• Work closely with DevOps, Development, Security, Product, and Service Delivery to align priorities, solve operational challenges, and continuously improve our services.Preferred qualifications• Several years of experience operating business-critical SaaS and cloud applications, combined with proven leadership experience in technical teams.• Strong hands-on experience with SRE and Operational Excellence, including observability, SLIs/SLOs, automation, operational KPIs, and continuous improvement.• Solid experience with incident, problem, and escalation management in production environments.• Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, networking, operating systems, and containerization.• Good knowledge of Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, technical resilience, and security principles relevant to SaaS operations.• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.• A hands-on and proactive mindset, with the willingness to understand the technical details of our D3 product family.• Fluent English skills.Nice to have Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:• ITIL certification or practical experience with ITIL-based service management.• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.• Experience with AIOps, operational automation, or cloud-native transformation.• Experience working in regulated environments, ideally financial services.• German language skills.What we offer as an employer• Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.• Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.• Be part of an international work force: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.• Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.• Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.• Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.Our commitment to inclusion:We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, genders and identities, and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive teamAbout usDIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH stands at the forefront of the financial technology sector, renowned for developing cutting-edge software solutions. Our innovative products encompass a wide spectrum, from pricing and settlement solutions for FX/MM businesses to FX market data services. With over 40 prominent banks worldwide, spanning Europe, America, Asia, and Australia, among our esteemed clientele, we have solidified our position as a global leader.At the heart of our success is our exceptional team, comprised of approximately 80 dedicated professionals boasting expertise in software development, financial mathematics, sales, IT systems, and more. Operating from three key locations—Hamburg (headquarters), London, and Singapore—we champion equal opportunities and foster a culture of respect and collaboration, ensuring a welcoming and supportive work environment for all.Join us as we continue to redefine the landscape of financial technology with DIGITEC.

Sie unterstützen diese Vision, indem Sie Ihr Know-how einbringen und Innovation, Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit als Werte teilen. Deshalb möchten wir unser Unternehmen gemeinsam mit Ihnen weiter entwickeln. Braun SEStellenstandort:  Melsungen, Hessen, DeutschlandFunktionsbereich:  InformationstechnologieArbeitsmodell:  HybridAnforderungsnummer:  7530Head of Platform & Solutions Operations (f/m/d)  The Group Digital Department, is looking for a Head of Platform & Solutions Operations. The Head of Platform & Solutions Operations is responsible for running B. Braun's Customer facing Integrated Solutions Portfolio and Digital Foundation platform in production, end to end. Service Integration, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), incident/problem/change management, observability, and service-level management all sit within this role's operating model. You act as the primary interface between the Digital Foundation's platform teams and the internal service organizations. You own the operating model end-to-end: starting with a pilot on one integrated solution in your first months, and scaling from there into a sustainable, audit-proof operating capability.  Tasks and responsibilities: - You build a pilot for one integrated solution within your first months, delivering it end-to-end with agreed interfaces, real SLOs in use, and a functioning stakeholder feedback loop- You design and implement a Service Integration (SIAM) operating model across multiple internal providers, including IT Service Desk, Global Business Service, and Global Technical Service- You introduce SLOs and error budgets on top of the observability stack and use them to drive prioritization and operational decisions- You establish modern, risk-tiered change management practices based on GitOps and policy-as-code principles- You build, lead, and grow an operational team or competence center that ensures reliable platform operations in production- You collaborate with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to define and fulfill supplier obligations under IEC 62304 and ISO 13485- You represent platform operations to internal and external stakeholders, communicating risks, incidents, and the roadmap in a transparent manner. Professional Qualifications:- You hold a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a comparable field- You bring more than 8 years of experience in platform or production operations, including several years in a leadership position- You have hands-on experience implementing SLOs, observability practices, and incident response processes in live production environments- You have successfully designed and operated a Service Integration (SIAM) or comparable multi-provider operating model- You possess practical experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), cloud-native platforms, Kubernetes, and GitOps-based change enablement- You have worked in regulated or compliance-sensitive production environments, ideally with ISO 27001 / SOC 2, while experience with IEC 62304 and ISO 13485 is a strong advantage- You communicate fluently in English and work confidently in German with enterprise stakeholders. Personal Competencies: - You build trust and collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries, including with stakeholders who do not report directly to you and in virtual, cross-site environments- You are self-motivated and hands-on while remaining calm and decisive during major incidents- You combine a structured and analytical mindset with the ability to act quickly under pressure- You are genuinely curious about modern operations and continuously expand your knowledge as technology platforms and regulatory requirements evolve. Benefits: - Company pension scheme- Mobility benefits, e.g., the B. Braun Job Ticket or Job Bike- Family-support services, e.g., vacation childcare- Flexible working hours such as flextime and mobile work- Employee discounts- Various working models, e.g., job sharing/part-time  Diversity makes us stronger! jobs.occupation: Project Engineer (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.Your Responsibilities:- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of themWhat You Bring:- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at bothHow We Work:- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities- You don't need to be based in Germany- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate itWhat We Offer:- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter. Instead, send us a brief project portfolio describing a project you have taken from the initial phase through execution and final handover, highlighting your responsibilities, key challenges, and achieved results.**Take Your Opportunity - **Join us and actively contribute to the continued growth and development of our company. Together, we strive to inspire our employees and customers through innovative technology, modern structures, and sustainable growthTogether Towards the Future. Are You Ready to Join Us?If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Ms. Jasmin Hohmann at +49 561 50019-201.Convince Us. We Look Forward to Getting to Know You!Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Projektmanagement, Anlagenbau, Fertigungstechnik, Schweißtechnik

jobs.occupation: Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) – Customer Service & Platform (Business-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Introduction/About usAs Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) - Customer Service & Platform, you are responsible for analyzing, shaping, documenting, and supporting the implementation of business requirements for the Customer Service and Platform stream within the global Customer Engagement ecosystem (Salesforce CRM), with a strong focus on Salesforce Service Cloud and Platform capabilities.You act as the key interface between Customer Service stakeholders, Product Owners, technical teams, and regional or local CRM specialists. The role combines strong Business Analysis capabilities with hands-on Salesforce configuration knowledge. You translate business needs into clear, testable user stories and solution concepts and can independently implement approved no-code and low-code changes within the applicable governance framework.Your focus is on scalable, harmonized, and user-centered Customer Service and Platform solutions. You ensure that global processes can be adopted effectively across regions while enabling appropriate localization for market-specific operational and regulatory requirements. You contribute functional and technical expertise across case management, customer interactions, knowledge, entitlements, service channels, automation, data quality, reporting, and related integrations.Your responsibilitiesBusiness Analysis and Requirements Engineering- Plan, facilitate, and document workshops, interviews, process mapping, and refinement sessions with global and local Customer Service stakeholders; CAT B2 theory)- advanced knowledge of English, knowledge of German desirable- willingness to work shifts (various shift models with allowances)We offer you, among other things: Development programs, flight discounts, Lufthansa shares, Lufthansa sports club.Salary is determined in accordance with the pay scale based on your individual relevant professional experience and qualifications.
